name: sync-types
description: Analyze and validate type synchronization between backend and frontend

check.description: Validate synchronization and exit with error code if issues found

documentation.overview: This skill helps manage type synchronization between backend and frontend TypeScript files.
keyFeatures: Identifies matched files, backend-only, and frontend-only files
Displays serializer camelCase transformation mappings from backend/src/utils/serializer.ts
Validates that types are properly synchronized
Provides reminders about snake_case to camelCase conversion
important: Backend uses snake_case for Prisma relations (e.g., brand_categories, style_components)
Serializer automatically converts to camelCase in API responses (e.g., brandCategories, styleComponents)
Frontend MUST use camelCase when accessing nested relations
RELATION_MAPPINGS in serializer.ts provides additional custom mappings
useCases: Before committing changes to type files
During code review to verify type consistency
